name: drive-cycle-watch
title: Watch codes through a drive
description: Records while the car is driven, from moving off until it has been stopped for half a minute, reading the fault code lists throughout and logging each code that appears or clears with its time. The person drives on a safe road, obeying the law; someone else watches the screen, or nobody does until the car is parked.
source: Stated reason: a pending code sets, and a stored code confirms or clears, only while the monitors run during driving, so watching the lists through a drive shows when in the drive each change happened. The drive ends when vehicle speed has read zero for 30 seconds.

phases.title: Before the drive
phases.instruction: Parked: start the engine, fasten the seat belt and confirm when ready to drive; leave the screen to a passenger or alone while driving.

phases.title: Drive
phases.instruction: Drive normally on a safe road; to finish, park and stay stopped for half a minute.
